blogs.title: Orthogonal Finetuning: A Simple Trick to Steer Image Generators Without Breaking Them
blogs.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT), explaining how rotating a model’s neurons with orthogonal transforms lets you adapt powerful text-to-image models to new tasks while preserving their core visual semantics.

blogs.title: Why Angles Matter: Hyperspherical Energy and the Secret Life of Neurons
blogs.description: Demystifies hyperspherical energy and pairwise neuron angles, using plain-language analogies (like phase vs. magnitude in images) to show why preserving neuron directions keeps a diffusion model’s semantics intact during finetuning.

blogs.title: From OFT to COFT: Adding Just Enough Constraint for Rock-Solid Finetuning
blogs.description: Introduces Constrained Orthogonal Finetuning (COFT), describing how a simple radius constraint around the pretrained model improves stability, reduces collapses, and makes hyperparameters (like iterations) easier to set.

blogs.title: Speed and Size: How OFT Beats LoRA and ControlNet in Efficiency
blogs.description: Compares OFT to LoRA and ControlNet on parameter count, training speed, and inference cost. Explains why OFT converges faster, needs fewer examples, and adds zero overhead at test time—ideal for practical deployments.

blogs.title: Two Big Wins: Personalizing Subjects and Following Controls with One Finetuning Recipe
blogs.description: Explains OFT’s results on two flagship tasks: subject-driven generation (DreamBooth-style personalization) and controllable generation (edges, segmentation, landmarks). Uses intuitive examples to show higher fidelity and better control.

blogs.title: Under the Hood: The Engineering of OFT (Cayley Transforms, Block Diagonals, and More)
blogs.description: Breaks down how OFT is implemented efficiently: Cayley parameterization for orthogonal matrices, block-diagonal structures to cut parameters, and channel-wise interpretations for convolution layers—all in accessible terms.

blogs.title: Measuring Control: New Consistency Metrics for Text-to-Image Guidance
blogs.description: Covers the paper’s control consistency metrics—how to extract control signals (like edges or landmarks) from generated images and compare them to inputs—to fairly measure controllability across methods.

blogs.title: What’s Next for OFT: Compositional Skills, Scalability, and Smarter Efficiency
blogs.description: Explores open problems and future directions, such as composing multiple OFT adapters, speeding up matrix inverses, and improving parameter efficiency without bias—plus practical tips for researchers and builders.
